configured Redis targets for Jedis 2.x telemetry","body":"Use each Jedis 2.x client's configured Redis target for stable database span attributes, span names, and duration metrics. This covers direct, pooled, sharded, cluster, and Sentinel clients. Legacy database telemetry stays unchanged.\n\nSharded targets preserve configured order. Cluster and Sentinel targets sort endpoints and keep duplicates. Cluster targets include at most five endpoints.\n\nDirect targets omit Redis's default port. Aggregate targets keep ports inline. Sentinel targets append the master name when it is safe to report. If any configured endpoint cannot be represented, stable telemetry omits the target.\n\nThis is the Jedis 2.x layer for #20010 and part of #19899.\n"}}
